astu bālyamatimaurkhyāśaktipāratantryebhyo duḥkhabahulam yauvanaṃ tu
tadabhāvānnānābhogarasarañjitatvācca sukhahetureveti spṛhaṇīyamevebālyānartha-mityādinā

saṃbhrameṇa bhogotsāhena bhrāntyā
vakṣyamāṇakāmapiśācā-dinā vā abhihatāśayo dūṣitāntaḥkaraṇaḥ

ācaturdaśavarṣaṃ māṇḍavyena maryādākaraṇānna tathā bālyaṃ nipātāya
yauvanaṃ tu nipātāyaiveti bhāvaḥ

ataevā'vaśamasvatantraṃ ceto lalanānāṃ yuvatīnāmiva lolavṛttīnāṃ
cañcalasthitikānāṃ cintānāṃ avṛttiḥ varaṇaṃ vṛtistirodhānaṃ tadabhāvān

yathā nidhyādidarśanāya bālānāṃ
karatale'rpitaṃ siddhāñjanaṃ lolavṛttīnāṃ tannayanaprabhāṇāṃ avṛtīḥ
anāvaraṇāni

tatra yauvane tādṛśāśayaṃ kāmacintādivaśīkṛtacittamataeva tadrūpaṃ
tatprāyaṃ taṃ puruṣaṃ narakādihetutvādvyayakleśasādhyatvācca duṣṭā
ārambhāḥ strīdyūtakalahādivyasanārambhā yebhyaste tathāvidhāste te prasiddhā
rāgalobhādidoṣāḥ pratilumpanti vināśayanti

ghanāni bahulāni garjitānīva sābhimānoktayo ghanānāṃ meghānāṃ garjitāni ca
yasmin

bhogakāle madhuramataeva svādu hṛdyaṃ tiktaṃ pariṇāmataḥ dūṣaṇaṃ
nindāhetudoṣāṇāṃ bhūṣaṇamalaṃkārāyamāṇam
sarvasya kṣaṇamanoharasya vastujātasya madhye agre agresaraṃ śreṣṭhamityarthaḥ

gandharvanagaradarśanasya maraṇacihnatvāttatpakṣe sarvasya vayaso'gre ante
ityarthaḥ
jyāmukta iṣuryāvatā kālena lakṣyaṃ prapatati tāvatkālaṃ sukhadam

bhairavākāravān bhagavānīśvaro'pi yauvanayuktājñānarātrernūnaṃ bibheti
kathamanyathā sadaiva vivekajñānacandraṃ dhārayatīti bhāvaḥ
duḥspar"aḥ spraṣṭumaśakyaḥ śokavahnistena hṛdi citte dahyate

kevalaṃ na
pūjayanti kiṃtvavamanyante'pīti dyotanāya tu śabdaḥ

rasyate iti rasaḥ sukhalavamakarandastena ke sukhe viṣaye saranti prasarantīti
rāgādaya eva kesarāstaiśca saṃbādhaṃ nibiḍitam

kṛtaṃ pāpamakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ laukikakāryāṇi vā kṛtākṛtāni
patanahetutvātku-pakṣāḥ

citākāśe prasādaprakāśavivekadṛkprasarādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ guṇānāṃ
sṛjyante sādhusaṃgamasacchāstraprayatnādibhirutpādyanta iti sargāsteṣām
śarīralakṣaṇe khaṇḍake alpe vanakhaṇḍe kuñje vā

śarīrameva marubhūmistatra kāmātapatāpenotthāṃ pratibhātāṃ yuvatā yauvanaṃ
saiva mṛgatṛṣṇikā tāṃ prati dhāvantaḥ

yeyaṃ yuvatā seyaṃ hi yasmāddehajaṅgale katiciddināni phalitā saṃjātaphalā
śarat śaratkālaḥ

kṣaṇabhaṅginā yauvanena mohādyo harṣamāyāti sa naramṛgo manuṣyaḥ
sannapi paśureva

puruṣārthapratyāśetyāśaṅkya na sarvaṃ yauvanaṃ nindyate kiṃtu
duryauvanameva suyauvanaṃ tu puruṣārthaparyavasitameveti
lakṣaṇaistaddarśayaṃstasya durlabhatāmāha - vinayeti

munijanā āspadaṃ sthānaṃ yasya āryajanānāṃ
